52468.author: artlbv
52468.body:
backport of #52466
to `CMSSW_17_1_X`. See that PR for the description and the validation.

`l1tCaloJetHTT` reads `("L1CaloJet", "CaloJets")`, which no module produces, so the Phase-2 L1 CaloJet HTT is always 0. The input is changed to `("l1tCaloJet", "L1CaloJetCollectionBXV")`. The cherry-pick applies cleanly; the affected line is identical on this branch.

#### PR validation:

See #52466. Clean cherry-pick of a one-line configuration change.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of #52466, to fix the Phase-2 L1 CaloJet HTT (always 0) in the `CMSSW_17_1_X` Phase-2 samples.
52468.title: [Backport of #52466] [L1T Phase-2] Fix input tag of l1tCaloJetHTT

52615.author: stahlleiton
52615.body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds back the displaced muon and the muon track extra collections in PbPb MiniAOD without affecting the current PbPb reconstruction. Checks done on 10k events of 2024 PbPb minbias data shows negligible impact on size or timing per event (at most 0.4%).

#### PR validation:

Tested with workflows 148,158,159,160.02,161.02,162.02,163.02,140.58,140.60,141.501,142.501,143.501,144.501

52629.author: oglez
52629.body:
Changing the NanoAOD variable Muon_tuneP_charge to int instead of a float.

This is a cherry-pick from a similar commit that was already accepted in master

We have changed the type of variable produced in the NanoAOD for the variable Muon_tuneP_charge defined in the file PhysicsTools/NanoAOD/python/muons_cff.py (just a one-line change to have an int instead of a float with precision 6 (that was used for unknown motivations).
Impact should be negligible both in usage and in performance. Perhaps a tiny reduction of the size if the int is easily packed than the float. The amount of information is the same.
52629.title: Changing the NanoAOD Muon_tuneP_charge to int instead of a float
